_comment: E-ink tags (MindReset Dot. Quote/0, 296x152 black and white), drawn and sent by dot_service (scripts/ctl dot). Hot-reloaded. Each tag shows what is playing (any mode), else (a screen live) what the room hears, the scene and the feel, else today's art, beside a column with the mode, the time, Auto/Mic/AI and a QR code: art.theme is a scheduler variable of the room's group (quoted: true takes its first 'quoted' phrase, else the 'else' variable), art.style another. refresh_s: how often it is redrawn while a screen of the room is live / otherwise (status changes go at once); the tag's wake interval follows it. sleep: the tag's nightly sleep window (local time). hint: the line along the bottom (every mode), telling whoever picks the tag up how to use the room. qr: a QR code (bottom right) any phone camera opens, no app; module_px = pixels per QR module (a bare https://host goes in upper case, the denser QR mode: 25 modules, 50 px at 2). link = where a phone tap goes (via the Dot. App / App Clip). The Dot. API key is in ~/.config/screen-machine/dot.json, never here.
